items.title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin must clear resistance at $81,700 to confirm new bull market
items.summary: Bitcoin's outlook remains bullish, but it needs to clear a significant range of resistance levels stretching to $88,700, CryptoQuant said.

items.title: OpenAI IPO won't happen this year, says Sam Altman
items.summary: "Given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public," OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told Fortune.

items.title: Revolut Leaks Passports, Bitcoin Transaction Histories to Fake Government Request
items.summary: The fintech company fulfilled a fraudulent information request sent from a government agency's own email domain, exposing ID documents and full crypto transaction histories for a "limited" number of users.
